failure_description: At +50°C ambient, CPU core frequency throttled from 1.8 GHz to 1.1 GHz after 45 minutes of continuous inference, dropping pipeline throughput to 24.1 FPS.
root_cause: Thermal interface material (TIM) between compute module and test fixture had localized void bubbles, increasing thermal resistance.
corrective_action: Replaced manual thermal paste with pre-cut aerospace thermal foil (CHO-THERM). Re-torqued mounting bolts to 4.5 N*m.
